capabilities: Copy Markdown selections as LaTeX on the clipboard
Convert wiki-link and pandoc citations into \cite, \autocite or template-based commands
Turn block ids and links into \label and \ref pairs
Convert Markdown tables, images and code blocks into LaTeX environments
Collect citation keys missing from a target bibliography via Copy Missing Citations
extras: The README marks bibliographies and captions as partial and the bibliography feature as experimental; the produced LaTeX requires the soul, listings, booktabs, graphicx and hyperref packages (plus tabulary, minted or todonotes for some options).
intentEvidence: Lighterweight than Pandoc, doesn't assume you're writing a whole document.
motivation: Written for people who do most of their writing in Obsidian with citations from a managed reference set and want simple, quick LaTeX output for fragments rather than whole documents.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes, especially ones full of citations and block references, into LaTeX snippets without running a heavier document pipeline like Pandoc.

relations.evidence: Lighterweight than Pandoc, doesn't assume you're writing a whole document.
Set Citation syntax to Pandoc to write citations the way pandoc and plugins like Pandoc Reference List expect them

summary: Clipboard converter that copies Obsidian Markdown as LaTeX, turning citations, cross-references, tables, figures, code blocks and admonitions into LaTeX code.
